qualifier: assembly and maturation control rather than selective cargo autophagy or lysosome fusion
name: Regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation
rationale: All members regulate or feed phagophore/autophagosome formation and maturation (including xenophagy promotion and vacuolar targeting), whereas confusables centre on selective cargo autophagy types (pexophagy, mitophagy, reticulophagy) or autophagosome-lysosome fusion.

qualifier: initiation and termination steps
name: RNA polymerase II initiation and termination control
rationale: Members concern regulation of Pol II transcription at preinitiation, initiation surveillance, elongation braking, termination and R-loop processing, with transcription-linked gene modules; confusables instead emphasise Pol II elongation complexes, Pol I/III and rRNA processing, or chromatin/ubiquitin modules.

qualifier: endothelial, perivascular and megakaryocyte-platelet gene modules
name: Endothelial, perivascular and platelet adhesion-signalling gene modules
rationale: Members are endothelial morphogenesis and cell-matrix/cadherin adhesion terms plus co-expression modules of endothelium, perivascular stroma and the megakaryocyte-platelet/myeloid lineage, distinguishing it from smooth-muscle SRF, fibroblast-stroma and ER confusables.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: entry, replication, protein maturation and assembly across virus families
name: Viral entry, replication and assembly across virus families
rationale: Members cover attachment, entry, genome replication, viral protein maturation, assembly and host translation hijacking for HIV, SARS-CoV, influenza, RSV, dengue and HCMV, whereas confusables are interferon/innate sensing or nucleic-acid editing and retroelement restriction.

qualifier: myeloid (monocyte and dendritic cell) predominant
name: Myeloid-predominant leukocyte surface protein signatures
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of monocytes, dendritic cells, T and plasma cells plus butyrophilin interactions, whereas confusables are defined by MHC class II or lipid antigen presentation and T-cell costimulation processes.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock response and refolding
name: HSF1 heat shock chaperone response and protein refolding
rationale: Members centre on HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding and stress-regulated chaperone activity (including UPRmt and mitochondrial targeting), distinguishing them from de novo/chaperonin folding, ER UPR, stress granule and aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly/reassembly and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi ribbon organization and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi disassembly, reassembly, ribbon formation and positioning plus membrane tubulation, whereas confusables are COPI vesicle traffic, secretory transport or Rho-family GTPase cycles.

qualifier: synthesis, metabolism and synaptic uptake
name: Catecholamine synthesis and synaptic uptake regulation
rationale: Members regulate dopamine/catecholamine biosynthesis and metabolism, neurotransmitter uptake and secretion and spontaneous transmission, while confusables emphasise monoamine transport, SLC6 transporter defects and dopaminergic signalling.

qualifier: AKT-FOXO and p53 axes
name: AKT-FOXO and p53 control of glycolysis and survival
rationale: Members combine AKT-regulated FOXO localization and transcription, p53 and mTORC1 programmes with control of glycolysis (fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, lactate, pentose shunt), whereas confusables centre on NFE2L2, hypoxia/HIF or core glycolysis.

qualifier: prostate and salivary gland
name: Prostate and salivary gland branching via epithelial-mesenchymal signalling
rationale: Members are reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling, mesenchymal proliferation and branching/bud formation of prostate and salivary glands and male genitalia, distinguishing them from lung, pancreas/kidney and female reproductive tract confusables.

core: Renal imino acid and glycine transporter defects
qualifier: iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria
name: Imino acid and glycine transporter defects in iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are proline/glycine transporter variants causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, unlike confusables about hexose, urate, cystine or neutral amino acid (Hartnup) transport.

qualifier: PD-L1 stability in tumour immune evasion
name: Neddylation and PD-L1 turnover in tumour immune evasion
rationale: Members are neddylation/COP9 deneddylation and cullin-mediated degradation together with PD-L1 glycosylation and degradation and T-cell anti-tumour response regulation, which confusables (ubiquitin chain types, PD-L1 transcription, Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation) lack.

qualifier: with renal and transepithelial salt transport
name: Osmotic stress sensing and transepithelial salt transport
rationale: Members combine osmosensory signalling, hypo- and hyperosmotic responses and renal sodium/transepithelial chloride transport, whereas confusables focus on specific cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels or sodium transporter regulation.

Members (anthrax and diphtheria toxin uptake, leishmania damping, SARS therapeutics, Rho-activated NADPH oxidase, CD163 anti-inflammatory response) share only a loose infection/host-defence context with no common process, receptor or cell type.

qualifier: glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and TET-TDG demethylation
name: Glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and TET-TDG DNA demethylation
rationale: Members are glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases (NEIL1/3, crosslink repair), direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT) and TET-TDG demethylation, whereas confusables cover downstream BER gap-filling or specific defective glycosylases.

qualifier: VEGF/FGF production and endothelial survival
name: Angiostatic suppression of VEGF/FGF production and endothelial survival
rationale: Members restrain angiogenesis by lowering VEGF and FGF production and endothelial proliferation and promoting endothelial apoptosis/activation, unlike confusables about sprouting angiogenesis signalling, its positive regulation or vascular remodelling.

qualifier: IL-12 family, IL-10 family and type III interferon
name: IL-12 family, IL-10 family and interferon-lambda signalling
rationale: Members are IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10 and IL-20 family and type III/alpha interferon signalling, distinguishing them from IL-17/IL-1-family, IL-15/IL-21, IL-37 and IFN-gamma confusables.

qualifier: interleukin receptors (IL-2/7/9, IL-3/5) and FLT3
name: Interleukin and FLT3 receptor STAT5 signalling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-3 and IL-5 signalling, STAT5 activation, and FLT3/CBL/CSF3 signalling and its negative regulation, unlike confusables centred on IL-6/IL-10 families, Th2/mast cell effector biology, M-CSF or erythropoietin/thrombopoietin.

qualifier: calcineurin-NFAT signalling and cell size
name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size
rationale: Members regulate calcineurin-NFAT signalling, cardiac muscle adaptation, stress hypertrophy and cell size/sarcomere organization, while confusables concern skeletal muscle atrophy, fibre-type transition or regeneration.

qualifier: agonist and prostanoid receptors (P2Y, PAR, TP, IP, GPVI)
name: Platelet agonist and prostanoid receptor signalling
rationale: Members are receptor-level platelet signalling by ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin, collagen (GPVI) and LDL, whereas confusables emphasise G12/13-Rho and Rap1 effectors, degranulation, adhesion or coagulation.

qualifier: with host retroelement silencing and restriction
name: Retroviral DNA integration and host retroelement restriction
rationale: Members cover HIV pre-integration complex import, integration and LTR circle formation together with HUSH/KRAB-ZFP retroelement silencing and APOBEC3G restriction, while confusables emphasise HIV entry/reverse transcription or HCMV latency and viral transcription.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKC (NTRK3), not TRKB
name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin receptor downstream signalling
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA-driven Ras, PI3K, ERK5, p38 and CREB signalling plus NTF3-NTRK3 cascades, distinguishing them from BDNF/NTRK2 confusables and from upstream TRKA activation sets.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane excitability
qualifier: TREK/TRESK and calcium-activated channels in mechanosensation and bladder
name: TREK/TRESK and calcium-activated potassium channels setting membrane excitability
rationale: Members are two-pore (TREK, TRESK) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels regulating resting potential, hyperpolarization and action potentials in touch, outer hair cells and urinary smooth muscle, unlike confusables centred on TASK/TWIK/THIK or KATP channels.

qualifier: aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and ERAD
name: Misfolded protein clearance by aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through quality control, aggresome/inclusion regulation, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, reticulophagy and ERAD, whereas confusables are ubiquitin-proteasome chain types or protein folding.

qualifier: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation, trafficking and clustering
name: Ionotropic glutamate receptor activation, trafficking and clustering
rationale: Members concern activation, trafficking, clustering and diffusion trapping of AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptors in excitatory transmission and plasticity, while confusables emphasise downstream CREB/CaMK signalling, long-term plasticity regulation or presynaptic modulation.
